_description: Representative ChemotaxisMinimal output (receptor + CoarseMotor). Simulates a step increase in MeAsp attractant at t=2.0 s from 0 to 0.1 mM in a population N=1000 E. coli K-12 cell. Shows transient adaptation response: receptor activity drops, CheY_P decreases, motor bias falls (more run), then methylation-based adaptation restores steady-state over ~10 s. Values are physiologically representative; not a literal solver output.

_field_notes.chemoreceptor_activity: Fraction of receptor cluster in active (on) state; range [0,1]; steady-state ~0.333
_field_notes.n_methyl: Average methylation level per Tar/Tsr homodimer; increases during adaptation to attractant
_field_notes.CheY_P: Phosphorylated CheY concentration in molar (M); drives motor CW rotation
_field_notes.motor_state: 1=CCW (run), 0=CW (tumble); stochastic per-flagellum state at each timestep
_field_notes.motor_bias: Fraction of flagella in CW state; at steady state ~0.65 (Cluzel 2000)
_field_notes.thrust: Net flagellar thrust in pN; 0 during tumble events; ~0.72 pN for 4 flagella
